# Reference sources

DadsEZCrafting contains its own source code and original artwork. It does not contain AAA Crafting source code, binaries, or artwork.

Biome progression, material grouping, food-stat terminology, and prefab identifiers were checked against:

- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Biomes
- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Progression_guide
- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Materials
- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Food
- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Item_IDs
- https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Future_content

Runtime Valheim recipe and item data remain authoritative for filtering and sorting.
